java.lang.Object

All Implemented Interfaces:

@Generated("generate.mjs") public enum IconSpecsRhStandard1 extends Enum<IconSpecsRhStandard1>
Icon specifications for Red Hat standard icons.

You probably won't need to use this class directly, but instead work with IconSets.rhStandard.
